The '''Mauphin system''' was a minor [[Star system/Legends|star system]] situated in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], in the [[trailing]] direction from<ref name="Lessons" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daupherm/Legends|Daupherm]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|191|''Discril''-class attack cruisers}}</ref> in the Core Worlds' [[Daupherm system/Legends|Daupherm system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> A [[Standard century/Legends|century]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that was fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Lessons" /> in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]&ndash;[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Unidentified Astral Jester captain|captain]] of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Astral Jester]]'', hoping to lay a claim on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] leading through the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], filed dozens of well-documented yet erroneous flight plans, including one detailing a route from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Lessons" /> the Core Worlds [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA" /> to the Mauphin system. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the flight plan mentioning the [[Star/Legends|star]] system had come to rest in the [[Phelar University Archive|Archive]] of [[Phelar University]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="Lessons" />

{{RPG|"[[Lessons from the Past]]"}}
At one point during that conflict, a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals researching the history of the ''Astral Jester'' in the Archive discovered the flight record.<ref name="Lessons" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mauphin system was mentioned in "[[Lessons from the Past]]," a [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] adventure included in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system. In the adventure, the player characters can optionally discover pieces of information mentioning the system. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Lessons" />
